name: b-panel-select
description: The Orca panel is in view and open for mapping (panelSelect on): a tap on a key that shows a pane opens it in the panel (keyPicked) instead of focusing; a free key opens in the panel too; panelSelect off gives taps back their focus. Revert check: ignore panelSelect in plugin B (plugin.ts): the tap on key 1 focuses pane a and no keyPicked arrives.
